summary: Gabrr2 perturbation supplies no transcriptomic efficacy or toxicity direction despite the target belonging to a ligand-gated ion-channel family with small-molecule pharmacology.
why_it_matters: Any GABRR2-directed pharmacology should be justified by receptor physiology in the appropriate cell state, not by this broad brain Perturb-seq signature, because the screen lacks target engagement and contains no significant biomarker response.
main_caveats: The dataset measured RNA after a genetic perturbation and therefore cannot evaluate acute agonism, antagonism, allosteric modulation, or chloride-current phenotypes.

summary: Adgrb1 perturbation did not knock down the receptor transcript in any measured mouse-brain cell class.
why_it_matters: Absent target engagement makes every downstream Adgrb1 null result primarily a guide/assay-engagement result rather than evidence that BAI1 is dispensable.
main_caveats: Target protein was not measured; the inference is from the Adgrb1 mRNA row.

summary: The Adgrb1 perturbation generated no FDR-significant RNA response anywhere in the assayed neuronal atlas, and nominal hits were sparse and non-recurrent.
why_it_matters: The observed signatures lack the multiplicity-corrected support expected from a reproducible cell-autonomous transcriptional program.
main_caveats: Transcriptional buffering and failed target depletion are experimentally indistinguishable here because Adgrb1 itself was not reduced.

summary: No robust Adgrb1-selective cell type emerged; the apparent 155 MB Glut and 215 MB Dopa tails were nominal only and had no target knockdown.
why_it_matters: Cell-type interpretation should not promote a single midbrain class or the low-count dopaminergic class to a BAI1-responsive population.
cell_types: 155 MB Glut|215 MB Dopa
main_caveats: Negative for FDR-level RNA phenotypes only; it does not exclude synaptic, protein-level, or developmental phenotypes.

summary: Adgrb1 was an engagement outlier relative to several assayed adhesion-GPCR and Rho/synaptic neighbors whose own perturbations produced FDR target depletion or downstream rows.
why_it_matters: The same experimental matrix could detect depletion of Celsr2, Adgrl1-3, Baiap2, and Trio, so the Adgrb1 null signature should not be generalized to the whole adhesion-GPCR/Rac signaling neighborhood.
main_caveats: Comparators are pathway-neighborhood genes rather than ADGRB1 complex members; their guides and expression levels are not controlled for.

summary: Known BAI1 Rac, Rho/ERK, and postsynaptic effector axes were not transcriptionally engaged by the failed Adgrb1 perturbation.
why_it_matters: BAI1 biology is often read through Par3/Tiam1/Rac, ELMO/DOCK/Rac, Rho/ERK, and PSD-associated signaling; this dataset provides no corrected RNA evidence for those axes downstream of Adgrb1.
main_caveats: Because Adgrb1 transcript was not depleted, the result cannot distinguish absent pathway biology from failure to perturb the receptor.

summary: The Adgrb1 all-null RNA signature should not be used to de-risk BAI1 loss in synaptic disease models or in the medulloblastoma p53 axis.
why_it_matters: Literature links Bai1/ADGRB1 loss to hippocampal plasticity, social and seizure phenotypes, brain development, and p53 destabilization in medulloblastoma; this screen did not achieve the loss-of-function state needed to test those mechanisms.
main_caveats: The Perturb-seq assay was acute, neuronal, and transcriptional, whereas key disease studies used organismal knockout or tumor contexts and protein-level endpoints.

summary: A restricted top-100-gene neighbor scan failed to identify a credible Adgrb1 proxy signature.
why_it_matters: Weak and unrelated positive or negative neighbors mean no other perturbation can rescue interpretation of the missing Adgrb1 on-target response.
main_caveats: The scan was intentionally restricted to Adgrb1 top nominal genes, which themselves were not FDR significant.

summary: Ankrd11 perturbation produced a sharply restricted adjusted transcriptomic response concentrated in 151 TH Prkcd Grin2c Glut, 155 MB Glut, and 191 MB P MY GABA despite measurable Ankrd11 down-regulation in many other cell classes.
why_it_matters: This refines a broad neurodevelopmental chromatin factor into a small set of vulnerable mouse-brain neuronal classes in this assay.
cell_types: 151 TH Prkcd Grin2c Glut|155 MB Glut|191 MB P MY GABA|066 CNU-HYa HY GABA
main_caveats: Lack of FDR-supported genes can reflect power, target-exon capture, or guide potency as well as biology.

summary: In 151 TH Prkcd Grin2c Glut cells, Ankrd11 loss primarily induced a synaptic receptor/channel and RGS module including Grin2b, Grm1, Gabbr2, Lrrc7, Kcnc2, Rgs16, Prkcd, and Rgs4.
why_it_matters: The dataset extends ANKRD11 chromatin biology to a mature thalamic glutamatergic signaling program.
cell_types: 151 TH Prkcd Grin2c Glut
main_caveats: Transcriptomic support only; no chromatin occupancy, histone-acetylation, protein, or electrophysiology measurement is present.

summary: Atp1a3/Atp1b1 and Kcnc1 formed a recurrent excitable-membrane readout: Atp1a3 and Atp1b1 were induced in both 155 MB Glut and 191 MB P MY GABA, while Kcnc1 was FDR-supported in 191 MB P MY GABA and 052 Pvalb Gaba.
why_it_matters: The recurrence nominates a compact biomarker set for Ankrd11-sensitive neuronal excitability states.
cell_types: 155 MB Glut|191 MB P MY GABA|052 Pvalb Gaba
main_caveats: The recurrence spans only a few classes, the shared logFCs are modest, and these transcripts are not proven direct ANKRD11 targets.

summary: 066 CNU-HYa HY GABA showed strong measured Ankrd11 knockdown but no downstream gene at FDR<0.10.
why_it_matters: This separates target engagement from transcriptional susceptibility and argues against treating Ankrd11 transcript loss alone as sufficient for a broad detectable state change.
comparators: 151 TH Prkcd Grin2c Glut|155 MB Glut|191 MB P MY GABA
cell_types: 066 CNU-HYa HY GABA
main_caveats: Very small effects may exist below the experiment-wide FDR threshold.

direction: Setd5 similar; Ankrd12/Ep300 near-zero; Med23/Wdr26 opposite
summary: The 151 TH Prkcd Grin2c Glut Ankrd11 signature converged with Setd5 but was orthogonal to Ankrd12 and inverted by Med23/Wdr26 on the same restricted gene set.
why_it_matters: This links two haploinsufficient neurodevelopmental chromatin genes at the signature level while warning that ankyrin-repeat name similarity or generic transcriptional cofactor status does not predict phenocopying.
cell_types: 151 TH Prkcd Grin2c Glut
main_caveats: Restricted to a top-300-gene correlation in one cell class; the cited literature does not establish a direct ANKRD11-SETD5 complex.

summary: The cortical L4/5 IT response and the low-cell MB Dopa and P/MY Pineal classes did not show broad adjusted Ankrd11 programs; their Phactr1 and Tub rows are singleton, hypothesis-generating signals.
why_it_matters: These rows prevent over-reading nominal target knockdown or a single adjusted gene as a cell-wide ANKRD11 program.
cell_types: 005 L4-5 IT CTX Glut|215 MB Dopa|217 P MY Pineal Glut
main_caveats: The negative call is statistical only; MB Dopa and P/MY Pineal had 23 and 35 perturbed cells.

direction: Ndufb11 down only in the two FDR-supported subclasses
summary: FDR-supported Ndufb11 transcript repression was confined to 155 MB Glut and 151 TH Prkcd Grin2c Glut.
why_it_matters: Only these two subclasses had enough measured target engagement to support downstream Ndufb11 interpretation; nominal effects elsewhere should be treated as underpowered hypotheses or failed engagement.
cell_types: 155 MB Glut|151 TH Prkcd Grin2c Glut
main_caveats: Cell-type selectivity can reflect guide capture depth, cell number, expression, or power; it is not proof that only these neurons are biologically sensitive to Ndufb11 loss.

direction: target transcript down with no FDR-supported non-self response
summary: In the two engaged glutamatergic populations, Ndufb11 was the only FDR-significant transcript.
why_it_matters: The immediate RNA phenotype of partial Ndufb11 depletion is target-transcript loss rather than a broad mitochondrial, stress, or cell-state program, despite NDUFB11 being a Complex-I/respiratory-electron-transport gene.
cell_types: 155 MB Glut|151 TH Prkcd Grin2c Glut
main_caveats: Absence of FDR-supported RNA changes does not test complex-I protein abundance, respiratory flux, ROS, survival, or later time points.

direction: near-zero profile correlations among Complex-I perturbations
summary: Ndufb11 did not share a detectably convergent RNA signature with 25 other assayed NDUF-family perturbations in the same engaged subclasses.
why_it_matters: Although NDUFB11 is a high-confidence Complex-I neighbor of many NDUF subunits, the perturb-seq readout shows a complex-wide pattern of sparse self-transcript effects rather than a common compensatory transcriptional module.
cell_types: 155 MB Glut|151 TH Prkcd Grin2c Glut
main_caveats: The contrast is RNA-signature based; most related perturbations also lacked non-self hits, so weak convergence may reflect buffering, dose, or scRNA sensitivity rather than true biochemical independence.

direction: partial down-regulation without a disease-like RNA program
summary: The dataset separates acute partial neuronal Ndufb11 mRNA depletion from the severe developmental, erythroid, and cardiac disease mechanisms reported for pathogenic NDUFB11 alleles.
why_it_matters: A missing neuronal stress signature should not be read as dispensability of NDUFB11; human disease studies involve variants that impair Complex-I stability/activity or assembly in unmatched developmental and tissue contexts.
cell_types: 155 MB Glut|151 TH Prkcd Grin2c Glut
main_caveats: The perturbation is in mouse brain cells and is scored by scRNA; the cited diseases involve human alleles, mitochondrial biochemistry, X-linked mosaicism or hemizygosity, and often non-neuronal tissues.

direction: Clasp1 up while Ndufb11 mRNA unchanged
summary: The single non-self FDR hit, Clasp1 up-regulation in 308 CB GABA, was disconnected from measurable Ndufb11 knockdown.
why_it_matters: This prevents the lone downstream-looking signal from being promoted as a cerebellar Ndufb11 biomarker without further validation.
cell_types: 308 CB GABA
main_caveats: A protein-level perturbation without mRNA depletion cannot be excluded, but the measured on-target transcript gives no support for Ndufb11 engagement in this subclass.

direction: Kif5a decreased in the four FDR-significant classes
summary: FDR-significant Kif5a mRNA depletion was restricted to four of 23 neuronal cell classes, concentrated in subcortical thalamic, hypothalamic/GABA, midbrain, and pineal/pontine-medullary glutamatergic classes.
why_it_matters: KIF5A is broadly neuronal, so the Perturb-seq response is better interpreted as a cell-context and guide-engagement phenotype than as pan-neuronal vulnerability.
cell_types: 151 TH Prkcd Grin2c Glut|066 CNU-HYa HY GABA|155 MB Glut|217 P MY Pineal Glut
main_caveats: The pineal/pontine-medullary group has only 28 perturbed cells, and absence of FDR signal in other classes can reflect poorer CRISPRi engagement rather than true biological resistance.

direction: on-target down; no genome-wide non-target response
summary: Even where Kif5a itself passed FDR, the downstream transcriptome was buffered: Kif5a was the only FDR<0.05 gene in each active class and the best non-target genes remained nominal.
why_it_matters: A strong axonal motor can be essential at the protein and axonal transport level without producing an acute, coordinated somatic mRNA state in this assay.
cell_types: 151 TH Prkcd Grin2c Glut|066 CNU-HYa HY GABA|155 MB Glut|217 P MY Pineal Glut
main_caveats: Buffered here means at mRNA level only; the dataset does not measure KIF5A protein abundance, axonal cargo movement, or long-term neurodegeneration.

direction: partial target-engagement convergence but no transcriptome-wide convergence
summary: The related neuronal heavy chain Kif5c overlapped with Kif5a for target knockdown in thalamic and midbrain glutamatergic cells, but its genome-wide DE vectors were essentially uncorrelated with Kif5a.
why_it_matters: Kinesin-1 heavy-chain paralogy and shared light-chain biology should not be collapsed into an interchangeable Perturb-seq signature.
cell_types: 151 TH Prkcd Grin2c Glut|155 MB Glut|066 CNU-HYa HY GABA|217 P MY Pineal Glut
main_caveats: Because both Kif5a and Kif5c signatures contain almost no significant non-target genes, the correlation result is a restricted-signature negative result rather than a pathway-level activity metric.

summary: Dctn1 and Dync1h1 perturbations produced dozens of FDR genes in the same 066, 151, and 155 classes in which Kif5a produced only its own target transcript.
why_it_matters: The muted Kif5a phenotype is not explained simply by an inability of these cell classes to mount a transcriptional response to cytoskeletal transport machinery perturbation.
cell_types: 066 CNU-HYa HY GABA|151 TH Prkcd Grin2c Glut|155 MB Glut
main_caveats: DCTN1 and DYNC1H1 are dynein/dynactin genes rather than Kinesin-1 complex members, so the comparison controls for transport perturbability but not for identical molecular function.

summary: Kif5a knockdown did not significantly induce or suppress measured Kinesin-1 paralogs, light chains, dynein/dynactin genes, TRAK/RHOT mitochondrial adaptors, or Nefh.
why_it_matters: The dataset provides no evidence for transcriptional compensation by Kif5c, Klc1, or Klc2 after acute Kif5a mRNA loss, despite their close network relationship to Kif5a.
cell_types: 066 CNU-HYa HY GABA|151 TH Prkcd Grin2c Glut|155 MB Glut|217 P MY Pineal Glut
main_caveats: Unchanged mRNA does not rule out protein relocalization, altered cargo loading, or activity compensation.

direction: dataset buffered; disease literature loss-of-function sensitive
summary: The absence of a broad acute brain-cell transcriptome after partial Kif5a mRNA depletion should not be interpreted as loss-of-function safety, because KIF5A mutations and Kif5a deletion are linked to axonal transport failure and human motor-system disease.
why_it_matters: Any expression-lowering strategy would need to preserve enough functional motor to avoid the KIF5A haploinsufficiency and axonopathy mechanisms implicated in ALS and SPG10.
main_caveats: The Perturb-seq cells are mouse brain cells assayed transcriptionally and are not adult human spinal motor neurons or long corticospinal neurons assayed for axonal transport over time.

summary: FDR-confirmed L1cam mRNA depletion in 151 TH Prkcd Grin2c Glut and 155 MB Glut was largely self-contained: the target transcript was the only FDR<0.05 gene in those signatures.
why_it_matters: Acute L1cam perturbation can be molecularly engaged without creating a broad immediate expression state, fitting a cell-surface adhesion protein whose major biology can be structural, spatial, or developmental.
cell_types: 151 TH Prkcd Grin2c Glut|155 MB Glut
main_caveats: Only mRNA was assayed; loss of L1CAM protein, axon morphology, adhesion, or synaptic wiring could change without an FDR-significant secondary transcript.

summary: On-target L1cam transcript loss was highly cell-type uneven across the 21 measured cell classes.
why_it_matters: The apparent L1cam perturbation phenotype is dominated by cells with detectable target engagement; weak signatures in many forebrain and GABAergic groups should not be interpreted as true L1CAM dispensability.
main_caveats: The data do not separate low endogenous L1cam expression, poor guide editing, small perturbed-cell counts, and genuine biological buffering.

summary: Perturbing L1-family paralogs and selected axon-guidance/cytoskeletal neighbors did not phenocopy the L1cam transcriptional signature.
why_it_matters: Cells did not behave as if CHL1, NrCAM, Neuropilin/Plexin, FGF-receptor, or ankyrin-linked perturbations were interchangeable with L1cam loss at the mRNA level, despite those proteins being in the same adhesion and axon-guidance neighborhood.
main_caveats: Correlations used rank-test score vectors; most L1cam signatures were weak, and absence of transcriptomic phenocopy does not exclude shared protein-level or morphological functions.

summary: A nominal 308 CB GABA response placed the L1-family paralog Chl1 among down-regulated genes, but this was exploratory because L1cam itself was not engaged and no gene was FDR-significant.
why_it_matters: Chl1 would be an attractive L1-family readout if it recurs, yet the present cerebellar signal is more useful as a falsifiable hypothesis than as a conclusion.
cell_types: 308 CB GABA
main_caveats: Only 48 perturbed cells were available, L1cam FDR was 1.0, Chl1 FDR was 1.0, and nominal p values were not robust to multiple testing.

summary: The Perturb-seq phenotype argues that L1CAM loss-of-function disease biology is not captured by a large acute cell-autonomous transcriptional cascade in the assayed neurons.
why_it_matters: Human L1 syndrome and L1 knockout mice have overt neurodevelopmental wiring and ventricular phenotypes, so therapeutic or safety studies should measure adhesion, axon growth, and circuit morphology in addition to RNA signatures.
cell_types: 151 TH Prkcd Grin2c Glut|155 MB Glut
main_caveats: The perturbation duration, cell maturation state, and readout are not matched to congenital L1CAM loss; this is a warning about assay scope, not evidence that L1CAM is clinically buffered.

summary: Pgrmc1 knockdown was directly observed in essentially the whole neuronal panel but produced a transcriptionally buffered phenotype with no secondary gene reaching FDR<0.10.
why_it_matters: The result separates PGRMC1's biochemically annotated heme, steroid, and membrane roles from a large cell-autonomous RNA program in sampled neurons.
main_caveats: Absence of an RNA response does not test PGRMC1 protein abundance, heme binding, steroid metabolism, cholesterol trafficking, or longer-timescale phenotypes; three cell types had only nominal target-transcript knockdown.

summary: The Pgrmc1 loss-of-function signature was uncoupled from the SREBP2 sterol-biosynthetic module even though that module was recoverable in the same screen.
why_it_matters: PGRMC1 has been connected to cholesterol and CYP51 biology, but neuronal Pgrmc1 knockdown did not behave like disruption of the sterol transcription factor Srebf2.
cell_types: 066 CNU-HYa HY GABA|110 CNU-HYa HY MM Glut|145 MH-LH TH Glut|151 TH Prkcd Grin2c Glut|155 MB Glut|191 MB P MY GABA
main_caveats: Srebf2 was a transcription-factor perturbation, whereas Pgrmc1 may regulate lipid handling post-transcriptionally; Cyp51, Insig1, and several other direct STRING partners were not themselves perturbed.

summary: Perturbations of available PGRMC1-adjacent steroid, nuclear-receptor, P450, and lipid genes were nearly orthogonal to Pgrmc1 across matched cell types.
why_it_matters: This argues against treating Pgrmc1 as interchangeable with progesterone receptor, Sigma-1, P450 reductase, SREBP, or nuclear hormone receptor perturbations in these neurons.
main_caveats: The closest paralog/complex members Pgrmc2, Tmem97, and Insig1 were absent from the perturbation library, so the comparison uses pathway-adjacent rather than all physically closest genes.

summary: The data do not support a detected neuronal transcriptional arm for the TMEM97-PGRMC1-LDLR/Aβ-uptake mechanism.
why_it_matters: If PGRMC1 contributes to amyloid or LDL uptake through receptor trafficking, Pgrmc1-targeted interventions may need trafficking, cholesterol-flux, or Aβ-internalization readouts rather than RNA markers as primary biomarkers.
main_caveats: The primary LDLR/TMEM97/PGRMC1 studies were in cultured non-neuronal or uptake models; Tmem97 itself was not perturbed in the brain screen.

summary: Nominal Pgrmc1 signature neighbors were not robust enough to nominate a new pathway or biomarker module.
why_it_matters: The strongest restricted-signature neighbors involved the thalamic/hypothalamic 151 class, but safe-target controls ranked at comparable anti-correlated scores, so these hits should not be promoted to mechanistic claims.
cell_types: 151 TH Prkcd Grin2c Glut
main_caveats: The neighbor scan used only top nominal Pgrmc1 genes because no off-target gene was FDR-significant.

summary: Pdcd10 perturbation produced no FDR<0.05 transcriptomic hit in any of the 22 tested neuronal cell classes.
why_it_matters: The direct survey argues that acute Pdcd10 loss is either transcriptionally buffered in the assayed neurons or insufficiently engaged at the RNA level, despite PDCD10 being a causal CCM gene in endothelial disease.
cell_types: 001 L5-6 IT Glut|005 L4-5 IT CTX Glut|007 L2-3 IT CTX Glut|008 L2-3 IT ENT PPP RSP Glut|009 L2-3 IT PIR AON ENT Glut|012 MEA LA CA1 DG Glut|017 CA3 CA2-FC DG Glut|022 L5 ET CTX Glut|027 NP-CT-L6b-OB Glut|046 CTX-CGE GABA|052 Pvalb Gaba|053 Sst Gaba|054 CNU-MGE GABA|059 CNU-LGE LSX GABA|066 CNU-HYa HY GABA|110 CNU-HYa HY MM Glut|145 MH-LH TH Glut|151 TH Prkcd Grin2c Glut|155 MB Glut|191 MB P MY GABA|217 P MY Pineal Glut|308 CB GABA
main_caveats: The absence of FDR-supported hits is a robust dataset result, but on-target Pdcd10 RNA depletion was itself weak and protein depletion was not measured.

summary: The most convincing on-target Pdcd10 transcript decreases were confined to GABAergic classes, especially 066 CNU-HYa HY GABA and 052 Pvalb Gaba, whereas the strongest Hsf2 downstream score in 008 L2/3 glutamatergic cells was not accompanied by measured Pdcd10 mRNA knockdown.
why_it_matters: This separates two follow-up tiers: Grin3a/Cit and Pdcd10 in 066 are target-engaged but FDR-weak, while Hsf2 is the closest transcriptome-wide marker but may be target-disconnected or off-target.
cell_types: 066 CNU-HYa HY GABA|052 Pvalb Gaba|008 L2-3 IT ENT PPP RSP Glut
main_caveats: All downstream genes in these cell types had FDR>=0.0525; Hsf2 and Grin3a were nominated from this dataset rather than from direct prior PDCD10 pathway literature.

summary: Pdcd10 loss did not induce the canonical endothelial CCM MEKK3-KLF2/KLF4 or RhoA-ROCK transcriptional axis in the neuronal dataset.
why_it_matters: The result narrows the dataset interpretation away from the vascular CCM program and cautions against treating neuronal Klf2/Klf4, Map3k3, Rhoa, Rock1, or Rock2 RNA as biomarkers of Pdcd10 engagement here.
cell_types: 001 L5-6 IT Glut|005 L4-5 IT CTX Glut|007 L2-3 IT CTX Glut|008 L2-3 IT ENT PPP RSP Glut|009 L2-3 IT PIR AON ENT Glut|012 MEA LA CA1 DG Glut|017 CA3 CA2-FC DG Glut|022 L5 ET CTX Glut|027 NP-CT-L6b-OB Glut|046 CTX-CGE GABA|052 Pvalb Gaba|053 Sst Gaba|054 CNU-MGE GABA|059 CNU-LGE LSX GABA|066 CNU-HYa HY GABA|110 CNU-HYa HY MM Glut|145 MH-LH TH Glut|151 TH Prkcd Grin2c Glut|155 MB Glut|191 MB P MY GABA|217 P MY Pineal Glut|308 CB GABA
main_caveats: The assayed clusters are neuronal and may not express the endothelial machinery that dominates CCM lesion biology.

summary: Available related perturbations, including Krit1, Cdc42, Mef2a, Mef2c, and Rdx, were essentially uncorrelated with Pdcd10 despite the known PDCD10-CCM and STRIPAK/GCKIII interaction network.
why_it_matters: The CCM complex is not transcriptionally interchangeable in this neuronal Perturb-seq setting; extrapolating from KRIT1 or CCM pathway neighbors would have missed the weak and idiosyncratic Pdcd10 response.
cell_types: 001 L5-6 IT Glut|005 L4-5 IT CTX Glut|007 L2-3 IT CTX Glut|008 L2-3 IT ENT PPP RSP Glut|009 L2-3 IT PIR AON ENT Glut|012 MEA LA CA1 DG Glut|017 CA3 CA2-FC DG Glut|022 L5 ET CTX Glut|027 NP-CT-L6b-OB Glut|046 CTX-CGE GABA|052 Pvalb Gaba|053 Sst Gaba|054 CNU-MGE GABA|059 CNU-LGE LSX GABA|066 CNU-HYa HY GABA|110 CNU-HYa HY MM Glut|145 MH-LH TH Glut|151 TH Prkcd Grin2c Glut|155 MB Glut|191 MB P MY GABA|217 P MY Pineal Glut|308 CB GABA
main_caveats: Ccm2 and the core GCKIII kinase genes were measured but not available as perturbation targets, so the related-gene scan was incomplete.

summary: Restricted top-gene signature-neighbor analysis found only modest and nonrecurrent Pdcd10 neighbors, with no high-confidence CCM or STRIPAK partner among the leading positive or negative correlations.
why_it_matters: This reduces the chance that another perturbation in the screen is a clean proxy for Pdcd10 and supports treating Hsf2/Grin3a/Cit as cell-local exploratory leads rather than a reproducible module.
cell_types: 008 L2-3 IT ENT PPP RSP Glut|066 CNU-HYa HY GABA|052 Pvalb Gaba|191 MB P MY GABA
main_caveats: The neighbor calculation used only the 200 largest absolute Pdcd10 scores per cell type because the full Pdcd10 signatures were weak.

summary: Corrected on-target Lmbrd1 depletion was restricted to 151 TH Prkcd Grin2c Glut and 191 MB P MY GABA, although the target transcript trended downward in most assayed classes.
why_it_matters: This separates interpretable, engaged Lmbrd1 perturbations from cell classes where guide capture or target expression was insufficient for a mechanistic readout.
cell_types: 151 TH Prkcd Grin2c Glut|191 MB P MY GABA
main_caveats: Cell type selectivity may reflect power, baseline Lmbrd1 expression, or guide capture rather than true biological requirement.

summary: Lmbrd1 knockdown produced no FDR-significant non-target transcriptomic program even in the two cell types with corrected target depletion.
why_it_matters: LMBRD1 is a lysosomal cobalamin escort rather than a transcription factor, so acute Perturb-seq can miss metabolite and cofactor consequences that are mechanistically upstream of mRNA changes.
cell_types: 151 TH Prkcd Grin2c Glut|191 MB P MY GABA
main_caveats: The negative downstream result is transcriptomic only and does not measure lysosomal cobalamin, methylmalonic acid, homocysteine, or protein phosphorylation.

summary: The screen could not reconstruct the ABCD4-LMBRD1-MMACHC cobalamin-export module: Abcd4 and Mmachc perturbations were absent, and the available downstream comparator Mmaa showed no corrected response or similarity to Lmbrd1.
why_it_matters: A lack of cobalamin-pathway co-signature should be interpreted as pathway-coverage and engagement limitation, not as evidence that Lmbrd1 acts outside its established lysosomal cobalamin pathway.
cell_types: 151 TH Prkcd Grin2c Glut|191 MB P MY GABA
main_caveats: Mmaa itself was not FDR-silenced in the dataset, so its failure to phenocopy Lmbrd1 is not a clean genetic dissection of lysosomal versus mitochondrial cobalamin biology.

summary: Multiple classes had Lmbrd1 as their strongest nominally depleted transcript but still produced no corrected downstream genes.
why_it_matters: Target mRNA reduction alone was not sufficient to elicit an mRNA phenotype, nominating 052 Pvalb Gaba, 054 CNU-MGE GABA, and 155 MB Glut as partially engaged but transcriptionally buffered contexts.
cell_types: 052 Pvalb Gaba|054 CNU-MGE GABA|155 MB Glut
main_caveats: These target-transcript changes were nominal after correction and may be underpowered rather than truly buffered.

summary: The quiet neuronal transcriptome after Lmbrd1 knockdown should not be read as loss-of-function safety.
why_it_matters: Human LMBRD1 loss causes cblF methylmalonic aciduria with homocystinuria, a metabolic disorder with neurodevelopmental and seizure features, whereas this assay measured mRNA rather than cobalamin metabolites.
cell_types: 151 TH Prkcd Grin2c Glut|191 MB P MY GABA
main_caveats: The Perturb-seq time point, mouse brain cell types, and partial knockdown do not model biallelic human germline loss.

summary: Nominal Lmbrd1 top genes and measured signature-neighbor perturbations did not converge into a reproducible state.
why_it_matters: Genes such as Pld3, Lman2l, Lrp6, Lrp2, and Med23 should be treated as local nominal hits rather than candidate pathway drivers of the Lmbrd1 response.
cell_types: 151 TH Prkcd Grin2c Glut|191 MB P MY GABA
main_caveats: This was a restricted comparison among perturbations available in an extracted comparator set; it was not a genome-wide signature-neighbor search.

summary: Ednrb perturbation did not produce measurable target-transcript depletion or any FDR-level transcriptome response in the profiled mouse neuronal classes.
why_it_matters: The central dataset result is a null result: Ednrb biology should not be inferred from nominal downstream ranks when the intended receptor transcript itself was essentially unchanged.
main_caveats: The result is high-confidence for the measured DE table but not proof that EDNRB is dispensable, because Ednrb was likely sparse in these neuronal classes and the experiment lacks astrocyte, vascular, melanocyte, and enteric neural-crest contexts.

summary: 046 CTX-CGE GABA was the Ednrb cell class with the clearest adjusted-p-value nominal tail, including Opcml/Kctd16/Rbfox3 up and Reln/Stoml1 down, but even this tail began at q=0.449880.
why_it_matters: This prevents the strongest nominal cell-type signal from being either ignored or over-promoted: CTX-CGE GABA is the best hypothesis-generating context, not a validated Ednrb response.
cell_types: 046 CTX-CGE GABA
main_caveats: All genes fail FDR correction; only 37 Ednrb cells contributed to this cell class; the finding is based on nominal p values.

summary: Ednrb, Ednra, Ret, and Sox10 perturbations did not form a shared Hirschsprung/Waardenburg-like program in this brain-neuronal screen.
why_it_matters: The canonical EDN3-EDNRB and GDNF-RET/SOX10 disease network operates in embryonic neural-crest and enteric lineages; the near-zero brain-neuron signature correlations show that those relationships are not portable to every neural cell context.
main_caveats: Comparator signatures are also weak or unengaged, so this is absence of convergence rather than a mechanistic antagonism result.

summary: The expected endothelin GPCR/phosphatidylinositol-calcium neighborhood was not robustly engaged: a Plcb1 match appeared only in the restricted CTX-CGE top-200 signature and disappeared at whole-transcriptome scale.
why_it_matters: The weak Plcb1 similarity is the only detectable hint of a downstream GPCR effector, but it is too restricted to claim activation of EDNRB signaling.
cell_types: 046 CTX-CGE GABA
main_caveats: The Plcb1 relationship used only 200 nominal Ednrb genes, Plcb1 itself had no significant CTX-CGE FDR hits, and EDNRB-specific coupling to Plcb1 in this cell class was not measured.

summary: The neuronal Ednrb null result should not be read as evidence against EDNRB-directed drugs or astrocytic EDNRB biology.
